case: The Cage, St Osyth 2004-08 — Vanessa Mitchell

voice.name: WTPN Samantha - Essex
voice.note: middle-aged Essex woman — the witness in her own register

segments.v_open: Something slapped me. Hard enough to turn my head. [pause] I was alone in the house, with my baby asleep upstairs.
segments.v_s1: I did not buy a haunted house. I bought a house. [soft laugh] A little cottage, in the village I grew up in — I knew the building all my life. It is old. Part of it was the village lock-up; they held people accused of witchcraft in there, hundreds of years ago. That is history. That is on a plaque. It is not the same as living in it.
segments.v_s2: The first day. Not the first month — the first day. [pause] A figure walked through my room. Not a shadow, not a trick of the light. Walked through it, while I stood there. And then it kept happening. Growling — a low growl, in a room with nothing in it. You tell yourself pipes. There is only so long you can do that.
segments.v_s3: It touched me. That is the part people go quiet about. [pause] Slapped. Pushed. Shoved by hands that were not there — and once when I was pregnant, which I will not forgive. And blood. Spots of blood appearing on the floor, in a house with nobody bleeding in it. I cleaned it up. It came back.
segments.v_s4: Three years I stayed. [exhales] People say — why would you stay three years? Because it was my home, and my money. You get used to being frightened; that is the truth of it. You start to think it is normal. [pause] Then one day you look at your little boy, asleep in that house, and you think: no. And you go.
segments.v_s5: I put my name on a book about it, with an investigator, so nobody can say I whispered it and ran. I have said it on television with my face on the screen. [pause] People tell me I made it up for money. I bought that house to live in — and I still own the thing, and I still cannot sell it. [soft laugh] Some investment. I know what hit me. Make of it what you like.

small: The witness bought the house to live in.

big: about it under her own name.
